brief:
Israeli authorities are preparing for three weeks of heightened operations at Al-Aqsa Mosque during the Jewish holiday season, according to Shehab Wire. The period is expected to serve as a gateway for imposing new religious rituals at the site and restricting Palestinian worshippers' access to the compound.

The planned measures reflect an established pattern of using Jewish holidays as occasions to expand Israeli activities and tighten constraints on Palestinian presence at the contested holy site. Officials have indicated that restrictions on worshippers will intensify during this period, with authorities using the religious calendar to alter longstanding access arrangements and practices at the mosque.
